videos.desc: A black-gloved hand pipes thick swirls of pastel whipped body-butter cream from a piping bag into small clear jars on a white table; rows of already-filled jars stand in the background.

At an outdoor tea table a man proudly combs and strokes his chest-length black beard while his bald, clean-faced friend rubs his own bare chin and mimes despair; they compare, laugh and take a phone photo with the comb in the beard.
On a porch, a young man holds an orange comb up to the camera, then combs his slicked-back dark hair while checking himself in a small wall mirror, saying his hair is "straight as a ruler".
videos.said: Listen, twang. Straight as a ruler.

videos.desc: A young woman winces as she drags a wooden hairbrush through a tangle in her long hair while her friend cheers her on; stroke by stroke the hair turns smooth and shiny, she shakes it out and playfully sings into the brush like a microphone.

On a snowy winter street, a woman with a coffee cup winces at her cracked dry lips, then rubs a lip balm stick over them and smiles because they feel smooth again. She hands the stick to her friend, who tries it too.

A woman in a satin robe sits at a lit vanity mirror with a big eyeshadow palette. A makeup artist dips a brush into the colors, sweeps blush over her cheeks and shadow onto her eyelids, and they admire the glowing finished look in the mirror.

At a sunny patio table with iced drinks, a woman shakes a bottle of coral nail polish, opens it and carefully paints her fingernails with the little brush. She blows on the wet nails and waves her hand stiffly, refusing to touch anything while her friend teases her.

In an ornate Moroccan-style courtyard at night, a young woman sprays perfume from a small amber bottle onto her wrist and neck, then playfully sprays big clouds of it at her friend, who laughs, waves the mist away and finally gives a thumbs up.
videos.said: Smells amazing. Too much, too much.

videos.desc: A woman dips a fat makeup brush into a clear jar of loose face powder and taps it, sending up a visible dusty cloud - "A whole cloud!" - which makes her friend gasp. She then gently brushes the powder over the friend's cheeks and nose and declares her "All set".
A man with shaving foam on his face shaves with an electric razor at a bathroom mirror while his impatient friend behind him taps his watch and hands him a shirt.
videos.said: (upbeat music) - Whose morning magic? (upbeat music) - Smooth in seconds.

videos.desc: In a home kitchen a mother holds up a pair of scissors, then trims her daughter's bangs with comb and scissors while the girl sits under a towel cape; the girl checks the straight new fringe in a hand mirror and beams.

In an animated hair salon, a green-haired stylist pumps shampoo from a bottle into her hand and lathers a client's black hair into an absurd swirling foam tower like soft-serve ice cream, then rinses it out and reveals a giant glossy hairstyle with a thumbs-up.

In a bathroom, a young man sprays a tall swirl of white foam from a can into his palm while his friend watches in exaggerated amazement, then he slathers it over his cheeks and chin like a fluffy foam beard in front of the mirror.

In a barbershop, a woman barber brushes white lather onto a reclining man's stubbled face, carefully scrapes it off with a straight razor, then pats scented oil onto his smooth cheeks while he jokes that it stinks.
A young woman does her skincare routine: she pats cream onto her face in the bathroom, pumps lotion into her palm and rubs it along her arms, then finishes on a balcony stroking her glowing cheeks.

An animated bald man in a red robe stands in a gold and green marble bathroom in front of a large mirror, holding up a small gold jar. A hairless sphynx cat sits on the washbasin beside him. A golden drop falls onto the cat's bare head and onto the man's bald head. Both heads sprout enormous hair: the man grows long thick black curls, the cat grows a golden lion's mane. The two admire themselves in the mirror.

A barber's shop with a deep green wall filling the whole background, a mirror and a framed picture hanging on the green paint, and green plants on the counter. A chimpanzee sits in the chair in a green cape with its eyes shut and a big round afro. A ginger cat in a white coat, standing on a wooden stool, works through the hair with a hot styling tool that sends up a puff of steam. The afro comes out sleek and straight, cut into a shiny black bob, and the chimpanzee turns to the camera and grins with the green wall and the green cape all around it.

A marble salon with warm lights and shelves of bottles. A lion sits in a salon chair in a black cape with its head tipped back over a white washbasin. A ginger cat in a white coat sits on its head and works white foam into the mane, then rinses it out with a shower head, so the wet mane hangs down dark and heavy into the basin. The cat then takes a large wooden hairbrush and pulls it down through the long wet mane, stroke after stroke, working out the tangles from the top of the head to the ends hanging over the basin. In the last shots the lion sits up facing the camera with the mane brushed out full and dry, and the cat perched on a stool beside it.

A barber's shop with a mirror and shelves of bottles. On the black leather seat of the barber's chair sits a very round, very plump hedgehog, so fat that its little legs and paws stick out sideways from a body shaped almost like a ball, with a big round belly hanging over its feet. A ginger cat in a white coat and red bow tie leans in with a pair of electric clippers and runs them over the hedgehog's back, shaving off all the spines. They fall away onto the seat and leave a completely bare, smooth, pale, round body sitting there. The hedgehog looks down at itself, its eyes go wide and its mouth drops open in horror, while the cat covers its own face with a paw.

A hamster in a fluffy pink bow headband goes through a skincare routine at a white bathroom basin. It drinks through a straw from a pink tumbler, presses the pump of a yellow soap bottle, then washes and pats its face with both paws. It takes a cotton pad from a blue TONER PAD box, squeezes drops from a pink Facial Serum pipette over its head, and finishes by pressing both paws into its round cheeks, with two drops of serum still sitting on them.

In a barbershop a young man in a white shirt strokes his freshly shaved chin. The shot cuts to a barber at work, then to a customer whose enormous black beard is being combed out — it is dense and bushy and hangs well down his chest. Then the door opens and an older man walks in with a beard so full and long that it reaches past his waist, and he holds it up proudly for the camera.

A woman in lilac pyjamas stands in a sunlit room full of houseplants and draws a pale wooden brush down her very long dark hair, sweeping it forward over her shoulder. She turns, laughing, then kneels on a patterned rug and brushes her golden retriever's coat with the same brush, finishing with her arm around the dog as both look at the camera.

In a barbershop, a barber holds up a small spiral-bound notepad with a curved shape drawn on it and points at it with a pencil. He then works on a young man's hair with red electric clippers, shaving a sharp line into the side and fading the sides down. At the end the client turns his head and we see the finished cut: curly hair on top, shaved sides and a clean shaved line curving above the ear.

A young woman in a coral top and a chunky yellow bead necklace dabs powder onto her cheek from a compact in a bright hallway, her hair piled up in a high bun. She leans towards a round gold-framed mirror on the wall, smooths her hair back with one hand and talks to her reflection, then adjusts the necklace at her throat. She turns to a large vanity mirror ringed with light bulbs, and in the last shot her hair has been arranged into two big rounded buns, which she shows off to the camera beside her reflection.

A smiling young woman with long bright pink hair kneels in a tiled laundry room beside an open front-loading washing machine. Her pink hair fills most of the frame as she lifts coloured clothes out of a laundry basket and pushes them into the drum. The camera then shows the closed machine with the wash turning behind the round glass door, and finally, filmed from inside the drum, she pulls out a clean white t-shirt and holds it up to her face.

A retro barbershop with mint-green tiles, chrome lamps, a black-and-white checked floor and a striped barber pole in the window. A young man in a striped cape sits in a red leather and chrome barber chair and makes an OK sign with his fingers, smiling, while a young female barber with her hair in a bun brushes cut hair off his neck and holds up a hand mirror. He then turns his head towards the mirror to study his fresh short haircut from the side. A jacket rests on a red bench.

In a bright barber shop, a young female barber in a white T-shirt and apron holds a comb and smiles. Beside her a young man in a cutting cape sits in a black barber chair, touches his messy hair and pulls a worried face with his mouth open, while the barber looks at her comb and laughs. On the left another young man in a blue T-shirt and cape smiles and looks down at his neat, short new haircut. Cut hair lies on the wooden floor and a ginger cat sleeps on a cat tree by the window.
